evidence.title: Add one bounded manual status filter to canonical Command Work Queue six-view browser
evidence.goal: Allow an authorized analyst to filter existing Command Incident/Task work items by one exact host-owned status without changing route, Shared Saved Views ownership or object permissions.
outputs: Literal status filter after authorization for each owner-resolved Incident/Task on all six views
Accessible status GET form and encoded six view links retaining filter with no new endpoint
No-filter JSON remains unchanged; filtered JSON states exact current status_filter, no unauthorized data
acceptance_tests: Authorized Incident/Task status exact projection, including empty/no-authorized-items and original no-filter semantics
Every owner object still receives current CanRead before filtering; foreign tenant ID never enters access checks; denied matching status leaks no data
HTTP accepts bounded optional status, refuses duplicate/oversize/control/invalid UTF-8 and client tenant/owner injection, no rows on denied session or source failure
HTML form/filter/navigation on same route for all six keys with safe URL encoding and owner-controlled XSS payload escaped

Exact-head Linux/macOS/Windows Go runtime + mandatory engineering-kernel checks, risk-proportionate security coverage >=90 changed scope unchanged; independent L2 on material status-filter boundary if published stable

rules: Canonical: CAP-CMD-101 Unified Work Queue, Command module Incidents and Work Queue; REQ-OBJ-001/012, REQ-PROD-013, REQ-UX-008/009. Full canonical §§1–27 (cmdr-product-spec/06-command/modules/incidents-and-work-queue/capabilities/unified-work-queue.md) requires a single route, six system views, manual filters/sort/selection/Inspector. Incident and Task status are Command-owned; Shared owns generic Saved Views persistence/permissions, and the Design System owns final Inspector. Neither is implemented or cloned in this lot.

Engineering: new one-behavior task E10-CMD-101D-STATUS, under existing epic E10-CMD-101, depends on E10-CMD-101C-HTML IMPLEMENTED. Complexity: one Command context, no migrations, no alternative authorization engine, no external package.

Code: product-runtime/work-queue uses existing Go stdlib Project, NewHTTPHandler, owner List/CanRead, trusted host SessionResolver, and html/template. Adds a literal, bounded status selection; does NOT invent a filter DSL, Shared Saved View or new path.
Git: a new child of PR #160 EXACT FROZEN HEAD 55d67812747f1893ee4f485247b167d20319fd67 (not main), all previously audited parent SHAs unchanged. Parent is a GIT relation, not canonical ownership.
